config.title: Harbor Agents
config.language.description: Plugin UI language. Auto follows the VS Code display language.
config.baseUrl.description: Legacy mirror of the primary provider baseUrl (prefer agentPanel.providers)
config.apiKey.description: Legacy mirror of the primary provider apiKey (prefer agentPanel.providers). Do not commit keys to git.
config.providers.description: OpenAI-compatible providers (base URL + API key). If empty, built from legacy baseUrl/apiKey.
config.providers.id.description: Stable provider id (for example: default, zai, kimi)
config.providers.statusUrl.description: Optional connection check URL (GET). Empty = Base URL + /models
config.models.description: List of models available in the agent panel (id as in /openai/models)
config.models.id.description: Model id sent to the API
config.models.contextWindow.description: Model context window in tokens (max input, used by the indicator)
config.models.enabled.description: Show model in the chat selector
config.models.favorite.description: Favorite model shown higher in the chat selector
config.models.supportsVision.description: Model accepts images (vision). If omitted, inferred from id
config.defaultModel.description: Default model (must match an id from agentPanel.models)
config.defaultContextWindow.description: Default context window in tokens when a model has no contextWindow
config.modes.description: Custom composer modes (Agent/Plan/Ask are built in). Each item: { id, label, description?, tools: "agent"|"readonly", prompt?, enabled? }
config.maxToolRounds.description: Base tool-calling rounds per request (default 20). If the model still needs tools, Harbor auto-extends by +10 up to 60, then asks for a final answer without tools.
config.speedRouting.enabled.description: When a heavy model is selected: Plan/Ask use a fast helper; Agent gathers context on the fast model, then edits and answers on the selected model. Disable to always run the selected model only.
config.speedRouting.fastModelIds.descrip: Ordered model ids used as fast helpers for Plan/Ask and Agent explore. Empty = auto-pick a lightweight enabled model.
config.speedRouting.readonlyOverride.des: In Plan/Ask, run heavy selections on the fast helper model.
config.speedRouting.agentExplore.descrip: In Agent mode, gather context on the fast helper, then edit/answer on the selected model.
config.visionRouting.preferredModelIds.d: Ordered model ids used for image messages when the selected chat model has no vision. Empty = auto (Gemini 2.5 Flash → gpt-4.1 → claude-sonnet-4-5 among enabled vision models).
config.maxResponseChars.description: Maximum chat response length; longer output is truncated. Repetitive loops are also trimmed.
config.soundNotifications.enabled.descri: Play a sound when an agent run succeeds or fails.
config.rejectUnauthorized.description: Validate the TLS certificate. For corporate CAs, use false or true with caBundlePath.
config.caBundlePath.description: Path to the CA bundle (similar to Continue requestOptions.caBundlePath)
config.commitMessage.prompt.description: Custom rule/prompt for SCM commit message generation. Empty = use project rules, then the built-in default.
config.figma.enabled.description: Enable Figma MCP tools in Harbor Agents (Connect in panel Settings → MCP Servers)
config.mcp.servers.description: Custom MCP servers (stdio or HTTP). Manage them in Harbor Agents Settings → MCP Servers.
